data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 喷泉圣水前的十指紧扣祈祷
data.description: 大理石喷泉前，换上圣剑战斗服的伊莉娜紧紧握住你的双手闭目祈祷。阳光穿透水雾在她身上折射出七彩虹光，她睁开琥珀色双眸，温柔宣告你就是天主赐给她一生的奇迹。
data.location: ancient church courtyard fountain with rainbow mist
data.action: interlocking fingers with partner, eyes opening gently from prayer, radiant halo glow, holy water mist in air
data.lighting: ethereal divine sunbeams streaming through stained glass onto fountain
data.mood: sacred holy romance, pure childhood devotion, uplifting spiritual joy
data.promptProse: Interlocking fingers by a church courtyard fountain, Irina opens amber eyes from prayer, smiling with radiant holy devotion.
data.animaCaption: Irina holding hands in prayer by a holy fountain with a radiant smile.
